name: Cycle
source:
On an isolated island ruled by a single king who has established “the law,” you encounter a girl who has been sentenced to punishment.

What is her crime? Why did she break the law?

Uncover the truth and press onward beyond it!
[Translated from Official Website]
translation:
在一个由制定“法律”的单一国王统治的孤岛上，你遇到了一个被判刑的女孩。

她的罪名是什么？她为何触犯法律？

揭开真相并超越真相！
【译自官网】
